class.name: NetwScene
class.brief_description: The scene an entity belongs to, reached as [member NetwEntity.scene].
class.description: A multiplayer scene is a [NetwEntity], available as [member entity]. Reach it with [method Netw.scene] or [member NetwEntity.scene]. An entity declared with [method Netw.configure_scene] resolves to itself, any other entity to its closest scene ancestor. Each scene has one handle, so [code]==[/code] compares scenes. A removed scene, as [signal NetwSession.scene_removed] passes it, still answers [member rid] and [member label], and its [member root], [member world] and [member entity] are [code]null[/code]. A scene replicates to a player while one of their [member NetwPlayer.entities] is in it, or while the player watches it with [method watch]. [method unwatch] does not remove a player whose entity is still in the scene. [codeblock] lobby.watch(player) arena.add_child(Netw.spawn_player(player, make_player)) lobby.unwatch(player) [/codeblock] Inside a scene, [NetwInterestLayer] still filters which entities a player receives. A player's entity is moved with [method Node.reparent] as you would normally do. Use [method Netw.reparent] when you need to await the server taking the move.

method.name: is_watching
method.description: Whether this scene replicates to [param player], either because one of their [member NetwPlayer.entities] is in it or because of [method watch].

method.name: unwatch
method.description: Undoes [method watch]. The scene keeps replicating to [param player] while one of their [member NetwPlayer.entities] is in it. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the watch is withdrawn, or there was none ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER a null player, or one this session no longer holds ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST this scene names no live node [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: watch
method.description: Replicates this scene to [param player] without giving them an entity in it, such as for a lobby or a spectator. A player can watch several scenes at once. [codeblock] Netw.scene(lobby).watch(who) [/codeblock] Watching a nested scene also sends the scene roots above it, but not their content. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the watch stands ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER a null player, or one this session no longer holds ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST this scene names no live node [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

members.member: The [NetwEntity] on [member root], or [code]null[/code] while [member root] is [code]null[/code] and once the scene is removed.
The name [method NetwSession.find_scene] finds this scene by. See [method NetwSceneConfig.labeled].
Every entity in [member player_entities] that was spawned for this peer.
Every entity spawned for a player with [method Netw.spawn_player] that is in this scene, in no particular order. An entity is removed as soon as it is despawned, before its node is freed.
The [RID] of the scene, which is also the [RID] of [member entity], invalid outside a session. The [code]scene_*[/code] methods of [NetwMultiplayer] take it.

The node the scene was declared on, [code]null[/code] outside a session and before the scene is live, which includes the root's own [method Node._enter_tree]. When the scene is [method NetwSceneConfig.isolated], [method Netw.spawn] returns the [StretchViewportContainer] holding [member world], and this is the node inside [member world].
Every player this scene replicates to, see [method is_watching].

The [SubViewport] above [member root] that gives an [method NetwSceneConfig.isolated] scene its own [World2D] and [World3D], [code]null[/code] for any other scene and while [member root] is [code]null[/code].

signal.name: entity_entered
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] enters the tree inside this scene, at the same tree edge as [signal SceneTree.node_added]. An entity added while [method MultiplayerAPI.poll] or a [NetwClock] tick runs, such as a client building an entity the server spawned, is reported when that poll or tick ends.

signal.name: entity_exited
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] leaves the tree inside this scene, at the same tree edge as [signal SceneTree.node_removed], so [member NetwEntity.root] still exists. An entity removed while [method MultiplayerAPI.poll] or a [NetwClock] tick runs is reported when that poll or tick ends. An entity removed because the session ended can report it with [member NetwEntity.root] already freed.

signal.name: player_entity_entered
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] joins [member player_entities], together with [signal entity_entered].

signal.name: player_entity_left
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] leaves [member player_entities], together with [signal entity_exited].

signal.name: viewer_entered
signal.description: Emitted when this scene starts replicating to [param player]. [member viewers] already includes them. A change made while [method MultiplayerAPI.poll] or a [NetwClock] tick runs is reported when that poll or tick ends.

signal.name: viewer_exited
signal.description: Emitted when this scene stops replicating to [param player]. A change made while [method MultiplayerAPI.poll] or a [NetwClock] tick runs is reported when that poll or tick ends.

constants.constant: The scene shares the physics and rendering world with the rest of the game.
The scene gets its own physics and rendering world on every peer. [method NetwSceneConfig.isolated] sets it.
